items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעֲרָה יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּתֻפִּים
items.answer_raw: And David came to his house, and behold, the maiden was coming out to meet him with timbrels.
And in its shadow many nations used to dwell.
They have set their arrow upon the string.
And I gave them to the priest and his sons for an everlasting statute.

items.body_raw: וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֵלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי
items.answer_raw: And the woman came to him and said, Behold, thy handmaid hath hearkened unto thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand.
Our end is near, our days are fulfilled.

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה הָעַלְמָה יֹלֶדֶת בֵּן וְקָרָאת שְׁמוֹ עִמָּנוּ אֵל
items.answer_raw: Behold, the young woman is about to bear a son and she shall call his name Immanuel.

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ זָעֵף וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא אָכַל לָחֶם
items.answer_raw: And he came to his house displeased, and he lay down upon his bed and turned away his face, and ate no bread.

items.body_raw: אֱלֹהִים לֹא תְקַלֵּל וְנָשִׂיא בְעַמְּךָ לֹא תָאֹר
items.answer_raw: God thou shalt not revile, and a ruler among thy people thou shalt not curse.

items.body_raw: אלה החקים והמשפטים אשר תשמרו בארץ אשר נתתי לכם לרשתה כל הימים אשר־אתם חיים על־האדמה כי עמי אתם
items.answer_raw: These are the statutes and the judgments which ye shall observe in the land which I have given you to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth, for ye are my people.

items.body_raw: Comfort ye my people, speak to (עַל־) their heart, and cry unto them that their warfare is fulfilled (full).
items.answer_raw: נַחֲמוּ עַמִּי דַּבְּרוּ עַל־לִבּוֹ וְקִרְאוּ אֵלָיו כִּי מָלְאָה צְבָאוֹ

items.body_raw: Plead with your mother, plead, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband.
items.answer_raw: רִיבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם רִיבוּ כִּי־הִיא לֹא אִשְׁתִּי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אִישָׁהּ

items.body_raw: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou and all the peoples that are with thee.
items.answer_raw: עַל־הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפֹּל אַתָּה וְכָל־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ

items.body_raw: And the captain of the host sent messengers to the king, saying: Make thy covenant with me, and behold, my hand (shall be) with thee, to turn-round unto thee all Israel.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּשְׁלַח שַׂר הַצָּבָא מַלְאָכִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר כָּרְתָה בְרִיתְךָ אִתִּי וְהִנֵּה יָדִי עִמָּךְ לְהָסֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל
